comment: Hello, I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to urgently bring to your attention a critical matter concerning the safety of our community in Millcreek. It has come to my attention that there is a proposal or ongoing consideration for digital billboards within our city limits. As a concerned resident, I implore you to seriously reconsider this decision due to the significant safety hazards these billboards pose. Digital billboards, while visually intrusive and unsightly, present a far more pressing concern in terms of public safety. Their bright, flashing lights and constantly changing messages serve as an unnecessary distraction to drivers, potentially leading to accidents and endangering lives on our roads. Studies have consistently shown that such distractions contribute to driver fatigue, decreased reaction times, and an increased likelihood of accidents. Millcreek prides itself on being a safe and welcoming community for all residents and visitors. Introducing more digital billboards contradicts this commitment and puts our citizens at unnecessary risk. Moreover, these billboards detract from the aesthetic appeal of our neighborhoods and commercial areas, diminishing the overall quality of life for those who call Millcreek home. As our elected representative on the planning commission, I urge you to take swift and decisive action to prevent the installation or expansion of digital billboards in our city. It is imperative that we prioritize the safety and well-being of our community above all else. I implore you to consider the long-term ramifications of allowing such structures to proliferate in Millcreek and to act in the best interests of those you serve. Please do not hesitate to reach out to me if you require any further information or if there are additional steps I can take to support this urgent matter. The safety of our community depends on our collective action and responsibility. Thank you for your prompt attention to this pressing issue.
